units: game world units; tune by listening in actual scale
rule: All event caps also obey category and global limits. Reject or steal lower-priority/quiet distant sources; do not stack every actor.

events.label: 短剑挥动
events.prompt: short restrained sword swish, dry close foley, no metallic impact, no music or voice

events.label: 长矛出手
events.prompt: short wooden spear release and shaft air movement, restrained woody transient, no music or voice

events.label: 弓弦释放
events.prompt: short wooden longbow string release, taut string snap and soft wood body, no cinematic tail, no music or voice

events.label: 木盾或木体受击
events.prompt: short dry wooden shield impact, dense wood thock, restrained metal rim rattle, no explosion no music no voice

events.label: 金属护甲受击
events.prompt: short dull metal armor impact, small body resonance, no long sword clang, no music no voice

events.label: 重甲兵能量放射
events.prompt: short focused electrical weapon discharge, dry electric crack and restrained low thump, no laser melody no music no voice

events.label: 轻型飞行器悬浮
events.prompt: seamless subdued antigravity hover motor loop, soft air and warm electrical hum, no piercing whine no rhythm no music no voice

events.label: 重型运兵艇引擎
events.prompt: seamless restrained heavy hovercraft turbine loop, low mechanical mass with soft air movement, no overpowering sub bass no music no voice

events.label: 舰队持续吸取
events.prompt: seamless focused suction airflow loop, restrained textured air movement, no shrill wind no music no voice

events.label: 吸取启动提示
events.prompt: short clear suction activation swell with dry mechanical latch, conveys onset of danger, no music no voice

events.label: 飞行器火炮发射
events.prompt: compact heavy energy cannon discharge, strong clear attack and short restrained tail, no cinematic music no voice

events.label: 鲲鲸吞
events.prompt: large creature inhalation and deep organic suction swell, controlled low frequency, short readable beginning and end, no roar choir no music no voice
